tests.body:
Ball ball = legal().extra(ExtraType.WIDE, 0).runsOffBat(2).build();
assertTrue(validator.validate(ball).hasError("off the bat from a wide"));

Ball ball = legal().wicket(new WicketEvent(Dismissal.CAUGHT, "IND1", "IND7")).build();
assertTrue(validator.validateAgainst(ball, innings).hasError("fielder is not in the bowling side"));

String line = commentary.describe(ball().runsOffBat(0).build(), null, "Kohli");
assertTrue(line.contains("unknown to Kohli"));

String line = commentary.outcome(ball().extra(ExtraType.NO_BALL, 0).runsOffBat(6).build());
assertEquals("no ball, 6 off it", line);

Ball b = ball().wicket(new WicketEvent(Dismissal.CAUGHT, "IND3", "Carey")).build();
assertEquals("OUT, caught by Carey", commentary.outcome(b));

Ball b = ball().wicket(new WicketEvent(Dismissal.STUMPED, "IND3", "Carey")).build();
assertEquals("OUT, stumped by Carey", commentary.outcome(b));

Ball b = ball().wicket(new WicketEvent(Dismissal.RUN_OUT, "IND3", "Maxwell")).build();
assertEquals("OUT, run out by Maxwell", commentary.outcome(b));

Ball b = ball().wicket(WicketEvent.of(Dismissal.HIT_WICKET, "IND3")).build();
assertEquals("OUT, hit wicket", commentary.outcome(b));

Ball b = ball().wicket(WicketEvent.of(Dismissal.OBSTRUCTING_THE_FIELD, "IND3")).build();
assertEquals("OUT, obstructing the field", commentary.outcome(b));

Ball b = ball().wicket(WicketEvent.of(Dismissal.TIMED_OUT, "IND3")).build();
assertEquals("OUT, timed out", commentary.outcome(b));

int target = dls.revisedTarget(250, 50.0, 100.0);
assertEquals(250 + (int) Math.floor(DlsCalculator.G50 * 0.5) + 1, target);

assertEquals("unknown",
        new Match("m", Fixtures.india(), Fixtures.australia(), MatchFormat.T20, null).getVenue());

Innings innings = match.startInnings(match.getTeamA(), match.getTeamB());
assertEquals(20, innings.getOversLimit());

Match test = new Match("t", Fixtures.india(), Fixtures.australia(), MatchFormat.TEST, "Lord's");
assertEquals(-1, test.startInnings(test.getTeamA(), test.getTeamB()).getOversLimit());

assertEquals(1, match.startInnings(match.getTeamA(), match.getTeamB()).getNumber());
assertEquals(2, match.startInnings(match.getTeamB(), match.getTeamA()).getNumber());

Innings innings = new Innings("i", 1, Fixtures.india(), Fixtures.australia());
assertEquals(-1, innings.ballsRemaining());
assertEquals("J Root", new Player("ENG1", "Joe Root", PlayerRole.BATTER).getShortName());

assertEquals("K Pietersen",
        new Player("ENG2", "Kevin Peter Pietersen", PlayerRole.BATTER).getShortName());

assertEquals("K Pietersen",
        new Player("ENG2", "Kevin Pietersen", "  ", PlayerRole.BATTER).getShortName());

assertEquals(new Player("ENG1", "Joe Root", PlayerRole.BATTER),
        new Player("ENG1", "Someone Else", PlayerRole.BOWLER));

assertNotEquals(new Player("ENG1", "Joe Root", PlayerRole.BATTER),
        new Player("ENG2", "Joe Root", PlayerRole.BATTER));

assertEquals(1L, pipeline.submit(MATCH, innings, delivery(0, 1, 0)));
assertEquals(2L, pipeline.submit(MATCH, innings, delivery(0, 2, 0)));

ScorecardExporter exporter = new ScorecardExporter();
assertTrue("archive should be empty before the day's play", exporter.isEmpty());

assertTrue("playing conditions were not the shipped ones: " + ScoringRules.describe(),
        ScoringRules.isDefault());

PlayerDirectory directory = PlayerDirectory.getInstance();
assertEquals(directory.byShortName("V Kohli"), directory.byShortName("v kohli"));

List<Player> found = PlayerDirectory.getInstance().search("kohli");
assertFalse("no player matched the fragment", found.isEmpty());
